question: D134 item 8: b10-blocking-aware sends only 10 to 52 requests in 600 s. Design or porting bug?
verdict: PORTING BUG, in the episodic path, not the recall path. The recall admission rule was never the problem.
how_settled: instrumented b10.decide() to tally which branch every recall took and what the gap rule read, at 16 devices, seed 4, 600 s, dry run, against b7-edf-feasibility on the same cell.

recall_path_is_healthy.reading: b10 releases 40 of 41 recalls against b7 37 of 41. The recall request count is NOT low and never was; the cold_q lock and the gap rule behave exactly as the card specifies.

the_actual_fault.what: B10BlockingAwareAdmission.decide returns Action(streams=[], ...) on every epoch, the only arm in baselines/*.py that does (one occurrence, constructed.py:625).
the_actual_fault.why_it_matters: coordinator._serve_monitor, which serves an episodic request and charges episodic_gpu_s, is reachable ONLY from inside `for sa in act.streams:` and only when sa.mode == "cloud" (coordinator.py:405-411). An arm emitting no StreamAction has ZERO episodic requests served, ever.
the_actual_fault.card_contradiction: the card declares defaults_used = ("episodic_mode", "cadence_s", "frame_count", ...), i.e. B10 is documented as TAKING THE DOCUMENTED DEFAULT for episodic streaming and being judged only on its admission rule. The code emits nothing instead.
the_actual_fault.why_apply_defaults_does_not_rescue_it: interface.apply_defaults fills fields on the stream actions that EXIST and never synthesises a missing one; live2 does not call it at all.
the_actual_fault.consequence: roughly half the workload was silently absent from every b10 cell, so every committed b10 live2 number is measured on a fleet whose dashcam half was never served.

fix.where: experiments/orchestration/live2/arms_published.py, class B10BlockingAwareArm, confined to the live2 port
fix.what: when the wrapped decide() returns no stream actions, emit the documented default StreamAction(sid, "cloud") for each connected stream, leaving cadence_s and frame_count None so the coordinator keeps each device own values.
fix.not_touched: baselines/constructed.py is deliberately NOT edited, because B10 is also scored by committed offline studies and changing it there would silently move their numbers.
fix.proof_the_fix_is_surgical: the recall branch is essentially unchanged: CLOUD on slack 40 before and 40 after, distinct queries 41 before and 41 after, deferred_hold 1425 before and 1382 after. The property under test, blocking-aware admission without slicing, is untouched; only the absent episodic workload was restored.

same_family_as: cards/simplestream.md records the mirror-image fault, where the docstring promised the documented default and the code emitted a literal StreamAction(sid, "local"). There it served the wrong thing; here it served nothing.
single_size_note: measured at 16 devices only, and flagged as such under the standing rule that any mechanism scored at a single size must say so.

_provenance.script: scratch instrumentation of arm.decide; no shared file changed
